      else 'portfolio_settlement.correct'
    end,

      when new.status is distinct from old.status then 'settlement.'||new.status
      else 'settlement.updated'
    end,
    case when tg_op='INSERT' then null else to_jsonb(old) end,
    case when tg_op='DELETE' then null else to_jsonb(new) end,

    case
      when new.approved_by is not null then jsonb_build_object('approved_by',new.approved_by,'approved_at',new.approved_at)
      else null
    end
  );
  return new;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.gridex_guard_company_hard_delete_v1()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
declare
  v_retained text[];
begin
  if current_user in ('postgres', 'supabase_admin') then
    return old;
  end if;
  if old.status = 'deleted_test_only' then
    v_retained := public.gridex_company_retained_history_v1(old.id) || array_remove(array[
      case when exists (select 1 from public.canonical_audit_events x where x.company_id = old.id) then 'canonical_audit_events' end,
      case when exists (select 1 from public.canonical_command_results x where x.company_id = old.id) then 'canonical_command_results' end,
      case when exists (select 1 from public.canonical_domain_events x where x.company_id = old.id) then 'canonical_domain_events' end,
      case when exists (select 1 from public.canonical_event_outbox x where x.company_id = old.id) then 'canonical_event_outbox' end,
      case when exists (select 1 from public.pricing_audit_logs x where x.company_id = old.id) then 'pricing_audit_logs' end,
      case when exists (select 1 from public.domain_events x where x.company_id = old.id) then 'domain_events' end,
      case when exists (select 1 from public.ediel_ack_transaction_results x where x.company_id = old.id) then 'ediel_ack_transaction_results' end,
      case when exists (select 1 from public.ediel_business_correlations x where x.company_id = old.id) then 'ediel_business_correlations' end,
      case when exists (select 1 from public.ediel_business_errors x where x.company_id = old.id) then 'ediel_business_errors' end,
      case when exists (select 1 from public.ediel_route_history x where x.company_id = old.id) then 'ediel_route_history' end,
      case when exists (select 1 from public.ediel_certification_evidence x where x.company_id = old.id) then 'ediel_certification_evidence' end
    ], null);
    if cardinality(v_retained) = 0 then
      return old;
    end if;
    raise exception using
      errcode = '23001',
      message = 'company_hard_delete_blocked',
      detail = 'Disposable tenant still holds retained history: ' || array_to_string(v_retained, ',');
  end if;
  raise exception using
    errcode = '23001',
    message = 'company_hard_delete_blocked',
    detail = 'Retained audit, journal and billing history would be cascaded away; close the tenant through canonical_transition_tenant_lifecycle.';
end
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.ediel_capture_customer_record_retention_origin_v1(p_table text, p_old jsonb, p_new jsonb)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$DECLARE t gridex_ediel_retention.record_tombstones%rowtype;
 o gridex_ediel_retention.process_retention_origins%rowtype;
BEGIN
 IF public.ediel_is_qualified_customer_record_transition_v1(p_table,p_old,p_new) IS NOT TRUE THEN RETURN false;END IF;
 SELECT x.* INTO STRICT t FROM gridex_ediel_retention.record_tombstones x
  JOIN gridex_ediel_retention.record_class_catalog k ON k.retention_class=x.retention_class
  WHERE k.source_table=p_table AND x.target_id=(p_old->>'id')::uuid AND x.company_id=(p_old->>'company_id')::uuid;
 SELECT x.* INTO o FROM gridex_ediel_retention.process_retention_origins x
  WHERE x.company_id=t.company_id AND x.source_table=p_table AND x.target_id=t.target_id AND x.decision_id=t.decision_id;
 IF FOUND THEN
  -- The captured full redacted hash is immutable evidence, not a hash of a
  -- later row whose permitted updated_at may have changed repeatedly. Current
  -- OLD/NEW state remains protected by the unchanged exact class qualifier.
  IF o.original_hash IS DISTINCT FROM t.target_hash OR o.redacted_hash!~'^[a-f0-9]{64}$'
   OR o.journal_retain_until IS DISTINCT FROM t.journal_retain_until
   OR o.journal_purpose_reference IS DISTINCT FROM t.journal_purpose_reference THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'record_retention_existing_origin_binding_mismatch' USING ERRCODE='23514';END IF;
  RETURN true; -- No insertion, replacement, new hash or historical fabrication.
 END IF;
 -- First capture still requires the exact immutable original before erasure.
 -- An already-redacted legacy row with no established origin must fail closed.
 SELECT x.* INTO STRICT t FROM gridex_ediel_retention.record_tombstones x
  JOIN gridex_ediel_retention.record_class_catalog k ON k.retention_class=x.retention_class
  WHERE k.source_table=p_table AND x.target_id=(p_old->>'id')::uuid
   AND x.target_hash=encode(sha256(convert_to(p_old::text,'UTF8')),'hex');
 INSERT INTO gridex_ediel_retention.process_retention_origins(company_id,source_table,target_id,decision_id,original_hash,redacted_hash,journal_retain_until,journal_purpose_reference)
 VALUES(t.company_id,p_table,t.target_id,t.decision_id,t.target_hash,encode(sha256(convert_to(p_new::text,'UTF8')),'hex'),t.journal_retain_until,t.journal_purpose_reference) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING;
 SELECT x.* INTO STRICT o FROM gridex_ediel_retention.process_retention_origins x
  WHERE x.company_id=t.company_id AND x.source_table=p_table AND x.target_id=t.target_id AND x.decision_id=t.decision_id;
 IF o.original_hash IS DISTINCT FROM t.target_hash
  OR o.redacted_hash IS DISTINCT FROM encode(sha256(convert_to(p_new::text,'UTF8')),'hex')
  OR o.journal_retain_until IS DISTINCT FROM t.journal_retain_until
  OR o.journal_purpose_reference IS DISTINCT FROM t.journal_purpose_reference THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'record_retention_first_origin_binding_mismatch' USING ERRCODE='23514';END IF;
 RETURN true;
END
$function$
